heading: New: the MileCheck dash display
intro: A small screen sits on your dash or air vent and shows the highway and mile marker you're on. It has its own GPS chip and stored mile marker data. It works without your phone or a cell signal. The first prototype runs on I-90. The plan is all 50 states.

images.alt: Concept render of the MileCheck mile marker display on a car air vent, showing I-5 northbound mile marker 142.5
images.caption: Concept

cta.text: If you want a mile marker display on your dash, join the early access list. Sign-ups help us fund it.

items.text: Navigate to a mile marker on the correct side of the highway. The route uses the right exits and overpasses, so a crew is not sent to the wrong side of a divided highway.
items.title: Navigate to a mile marker

items.text: The Menu has a Cameras page. Scroll through nearby DOT cameras, pick a highway and star the ones you check most.
items.title: Cameras page in the app

items.text: On iPhone, the Snowplows map layer shows where plow trucks last reported. Only some states and provinces publish live plow positions. In those, the Mile tab shows the nearest plow ahead on your road.
items.title: Snowplows on iPhone

items.text: iPhone version 1.10.44 and Android version 1.10.40 are in the stores. Make sure your app is up to date.
items.title: Update your app
items.textHtml: iPhone version 1.10.44 and Android version 1.10.40 are in the stores. Make sure your app is up to date.

items.text: Each truck's last reported location, in 14 US states and 3 Canadian provinces. Only some agencies publish live plow positions.
items.title: Snowplow map

items.text: Pages for 63 ski areas, with the roads in, their cameras and the snow forecast.
items.title: Ski areas

items.text: New pass pages for Coquihalla, Sea-to-Sky, Rogers Pass, Kootenay Pass, Wolf Creek, Monarch, Mt Hood, Santiam, White Pass and more.
items.title: Mountain pass pages

items.text: Late-November driving guides for I-5, I-40, I-70, I-80 and I-90 are up ahead of Thanksgiving. We'll keep them updated through the holiday. The November report will cover Thanksgiving travel.
items.title: Thanksgiving driving guides

items.text: A current storms page, updated twice a day.
items.title: Current storms

items.text: A map of 20,031 open public railroad crossings at road level on state highway systems, from FRA records.
items.title: Railroad crossings map

items.text: Live traffic camera pages for 161 US cities, each with every DOT camera in and around that city on one page.
items.title: City camera pages

heading: For fleet software, mobile apps and DOTs

items.text: A free 14-day API test key, 100 calls a day. Live border waits are in the Business plan.
items.title: API test key

items.text: Corridor display boards are TVs in truck stops, travel centers or diners. They show live road conditions for the highway outside. The board is free for the store. The store gets a share when its sponsor slot sells. One sponsor per screen. First up is US 2 over Stevens Pass.
items.title: Corridor display boards

items.text: Dash displays are for fleets, plow trucks and tow trucks. Add your vehicle count to the early access form.
items.title: Dash displays for fleets

items.text: If you build software and want mile markers in it, the dataset is available as a file: GeoJSON and CSV, all 50 states and 10 Canadian provinces and territories, with a monthly snapshot of what changed. Flat yearly fee, no call limits. A free sample is on the page.
items.title: Mile marker data license

items.text: Mountain Visibility shows whether the mountain is out right now. It covers Mount Rainier, Mount Hood, Mount Baker, Mount St. Helens, Denali, the Olympics, Mount Angeles and Mount Baldy.
items.title: Mountain Visibility

items.text: Seattle Drawbridges shows which of Seattle's five drawbridges are up right now. It works on iPhone and in CarPlay.
items.title: Seattle Drawbridges
